claim_boundary: Zero-shot external residue-interface generalization only. This is not a CHIMERA CDR-design leaderboard submission, a docking benchmark, a clinical claim, or evidence of state of the art.

data_firewall.development_after_external_access: No candidate, checkpoint, hyperparameter, residue mapping rule, exclusion rule, threshold, metric, or ensemble weight may be changed after the first CHIMERA row-level annotation is read.

eligibility_and_mapping.antibody_axis: Concatenate heavy then light residues; assign distinct chain IDs. A missing light chain is allowed only when the source explicitly records a heavy-only antibody.
eligibility_and_mapping.antigen_axis: Preserve every antigen chain and assign distinct chain IDs. Never collapse a multichain antigen into one geometric chain.
eligibility_and_mapping.backbone: Use real N/CA/C coordinates only. A residue frame is valid iff all three atoms are finite; otherwise preserve the residue and set its explicit missing-frame mask.
exclusions: missing pinned split member or complex feature artifact
sequence-to-coordinate or annotation-to-residue mapping is non-unique
duplicate complex ID with conflicting payloads
empty antibody or antigen residue axis
eligibility_and_mapping.label_source: Use CHIMERA-provided epitope_residues and paratope_residues, cross-checked against contact_pairs and the documented 4.5-A contact cutoff. Any disagreement is quarantined, never resolved with model scores.
eligibility_and_mapping.length_policy: No score-dependent or post-hoc length exclusion. Evaluate one complex per batch with no preregistered sequence-length cap; deterministic OOM or unsupported length is reported as adapter failure and coverage loss.
eligibility_and_mapping.mapping_failure_policy: Fail closed per complex and publish every excluded complex ID with one score-independent reason before metrics are computed. If usable coverage is below 95% on either primary split, confirmatory interpretation is forbidden.

group_key_priority: official antigen cluster or fold group
bootstrap.resampling: paired group bootstrap; both candidates and every seed stay paired

evaluation.ensemble: Arithmetic mean of per-residue probabilities across seeds 17, 42, and 73; equal weights fixed before external access.
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two co-primary split-level hypotheses.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Mean per-complex epitope AUPRC difference of the fixed-final seed ensemble.
secondary_endpoints: pooled epitope and paratope AUPRC and AUROC
precision, recall, F1, and MCC at the fixed threshold 0.5
evaluation.success_rule: Support requires a positive paired difference with a 95% group-bootstrap lower bound above zero and Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05 on a co-primary split. Otherwise report no confirmatory support for that split.
evaluation.threshold_policy: The 0.5 threshold is fixed and descriptive. No CHIMERA calibration, threshold search, early stopping, refit, or checkpoint selection is allowed.

model.checkpoint_rule: Fixed epoch 20 only for the primary comparison; no external selection.

must_publish: protocol and all input/source/checkpoint SHA-256 digests
all eligible, evaluated, excluded, and failed counts by split
absolute candidate metrics and paired differences with intervals
overlap audit against SAbDab2 training/development sequences
negative or null results without changing the protocol
prohibited: using external scores to choose a geometry mode or checkpoint
calling this a frozen-test result if source admission remains incomplete
claiming improvement on the canonical CHIMERA generative-design task
hiding adapter exclusions, overlap, or failed complexes
